basis: Direct review of four fresh headed-Chrome screenshots of the actual shipped WebP over the full 540x960 arena at DPR 1. Native PNGs are the acceptance evidence; 8x nearest-neighbor crops are diagnostics only.
body_scale_measurement: Source image alpha bounds use alpha >= 128/255, not the full canvas. Browser-measured body heights: 12.99591064453125 CSS px at requested 13; 25.999465942382812 CSS px at requested 26.

13_css_px.head_shape: Readable as a distinct auburn head silhouette on both tones.
13_css_px.apron: The teal torso block remains distinct on both tones.
13_css_px.copper_sickle: The blade collapses to a small orange mark; the open crescent does not read clearly at native size.
13_css_px.separate_feet: The two feet do not resolve as separate shapes at native size, especially on the dark arena.

26_css_px.copper_sickle: The open crescent and handle read as one held tool.
26_css_px.separate_feet: The two feet are visibly separated.

overall_result: FAIL: the 13 CSS px requirement is not met on both arena tones.
